findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: sfmono-regular. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files, or switch to a Google Fonts family. An OS font such as PingFang SC or Hiragino Sans renders locally from the installed copy, but a cloud render has no copy and refuses it.

findings.message: Audio "review-click" is 0.01s but its slot (data-duration) is 0.50s — the slot is shortened to the media length when rendered. Set data-duration to ~0.01s if that isn't intended.
